(Capacity: 12,508) | champion= | bowl=[[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | bowl_result = round of 64 }} {{2012–13 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2012–13 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Pittsburgh]], widely known as "Pitt", in the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers' head coach was [[Jamie Dixon]], in his 10th year as head coach and 14th overall at Pitt. The team played its home games in the [[Petersen Events Center]] in [[Pittsburgh]] and was in its final season as a member of the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. Pitt played in the [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] the following season. They finished the conference season with 12–6 in the Big East Conference, which they placed 4th. In the postseason, they lost to [[2012–13 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2013 Big East men's basketball tournament]] and lost in the first round of [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2013 NCAA tournament]] to [[2012–13 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]] to conclude the season with an overall record of
